provenance.note: a short kick whose punch sits over the line's sub, for the fast broken beat (his ear on DNB-6, 10-05: our drums' tone is far): source 8's kick read at its drop, onset by onset with what sounded before it taken out, has its body at 100 Hz and stands within 8 dB of its peak from 63 to 400 Hz, -15 at 400-630 and -21 at 630 Hz-1 kHz, where the tight kick's body sat at 65 Hz and fell 18-22 dB by 160-400 Hz and 40-50 by 400 Hz-1 kHz; so the drop onto 70 Hz from twice it over 30 ms, the body open to 900 Hz and driven 1.0 for the partials over it, the click at 3 kHz, and the ring a little longer (t10 45 ms). Revision 2 (the liquid bass rounds, 10-07): a rounded output contour over every hit — from 0.35 to full over 24 ms, held to 35 ms, then down through 0.65 at 65 ms, 0.25 at 105, 0.05 at 160 and 0.02 at 250 ms — so the kick's pressure is one short rounded push and not a long flat top under the line. Its depth (the liquid knobs, 10-07) is a desk line, `contour.depth`: 1 is that pillow, 0 is revision 1's kick, flat; how much of the contour each hit is played with, every gain g heard as g x depth + (1 - depth).
